evidence.claim: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns skill ID 541 to Boiling Ball, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Demon God Demigra (Final Form) as its source.
A Xenoverse 2 skill-list artifact places Boiling Ball in the Super Skills section and identifies it as skill ID 541.
Legend Patrol's Defend History! Unknown Battle lists Boiling Ball on Final Form Demigra.
Xenoverse 2 Demigra reference material describes Boiling Ball as a Final Demigra attack involving three spinning dark-energy spheres that target the opponent.
A Xenoverse 2 catalog of skills unobtainable by CaC lists Boiling Ball.

resolved_fields.attack_description: Final Demigra teleports away, forms three spinning dark-energy spheres, and uses them to target the opponent; the move has a distinct transformation/Time Rift behavior.
